boundary: Only intrinsic clearance is measured. Concentration, target occupancy and effect are illustrative model outputs under declared, unmeasured parameters. The within-cohort rat-to-human hepatocyte ratio interval is not validated species translation, and no clinical response or compound ranking follows.

counted_unit.excluded_from_conversion: Microsome clearance is per gram protein, not per million cells
counted_unit.measurements: The parent median of exact, uncensored intrinsic-clearance activities admitted by the frozen AZ clearance-system reader in each named assay
counted_unit.modelled_if: admitted in both human and rat hepatocyte assays

excluded_by_design: a prediction of clinical exposure, efficacy or response
an assertion that target engagement or response was measured
a claim that rat-to-human species translation was externally validated
a ranking of compounds by predicted response
a silent conversion between microsome per-protein and hepatocyte per-cell clearance

species_factor.source: paired parent clearances from the two ChEMBL 37 hepatocyte assays
species_factor.value: per-parent leave-one-out median with empirical quantile bounds

equations: r_i = median(CL_h/CL_r among paired parents except i)

model.translation_rule: For each paired parent, derive a rat-to-human hepatocyte clearance factor from the other paired parents. Use their median for the central curve and their empirical quantiles for a variability interval. Never use the parent's own human measurement to derive its factor.
model.uncertainty_rule: Interval arithmetic propagates assumed rat-assay uncertainty, leave-one-out species-factor variability, unbound fraction, binding constant, Emax and engagement EC50 through each monotone equation. These are sensitivity bounds, not confidence or prediction intervals.
